text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Why do you need to take so much?
choice_data_list: I thought you'd be happy if there were a lot, so...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Me? ...In the first place, I never said anything about needing it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I have plans to have a dinner meeting with the people involved with this product soon.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Getting to experience a few of the genuine articles like this should give me plenty to talk about. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However—such things won't be necessary in the future.
Please keep that well in mind."
